### Post-cancellation refresh is unverified with an active status filter

- **Changed surface:** Cancellation now refreshes the list using the selected status at [history.js:213](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/history.js:213).
- **Impacted consumer or site:** The “待开始” filter on `/my`, defined at [my.html:19](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/templates/my.html:19).
- **Existing test evidence:** `Regression gap`. The cancellation test at [test_history_js.cjs:190](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/tests/test_history_js.cjs:190) leaves the filter empty and explicitly expects `/api/bookings/mine`. The browser cancellation scenario at [verify_member_cancel_browser.cjs:36](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_member_cancel_browser.cjs:36) also uses the default all-status list. Repository searches for the cancellation symbols, route, and `history.js` found no additional filtered-cancellation scenario.
- **Missing verification:** Cancel while `status=pending`; assert the refresh requests that status, the cancelled item disappears from the filtered list, and its cancelled detail remains visible.
- **Demonstration:** I replaced only the post-cancellation `const status = select.value` with `const status = ""` in memory. All 34 history-handler tests still passed. The browser scenario would likewise retain its existing default-filter behavior.
- **Consequence:** A regression could populate a visibly “待开始” list with cancelled and other-status records after cancellation.
- **Disposition:** `patch` — add a filtered-cancellation case to `tests/test_history_js.cjs`.

### Session expiry during the post-cancellation refresh is unverified

- **Changed surface:** The new follow-up read clears protected content when it returns `AUTH_REQUIRED` at [history.js:217](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/history.js:217).
- **Impacted consumer or site:** `/my` after a successful cancellation, while awaiting its automatic list refresh.
- **Existing test evidence:** `Regression gap`. The follow-up failure test at [test_history_js.cjs:227](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/tests/test_history_js.cjs:227) injects a network `TypeError`. The session-loss test at line 234 fails the cancellation POST itself. The browser expiry scenario at [verify_member_cancel_browser.cjs:101](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_member_cancel_browser.cjs:101) also logs out before the POST. None of these tests exercises successful POST followed by unauthorized GET.
- **Missing verification:** Return a valid cancelled DTO from the POST, then `AUTH_REQUIRED` from the refresh; assert protected list/detail content is cleared, cancellation controls are hidden, and login feedback appears.
- **Demonstration:** I removed only the follow-up catch’s `expired(error, feedback)` call in memory. All 34 history-handler tests still passed because the existing unauthorized cases enter other catches.
- **Consequence:** This regression would leave personal booking information visible after the refresh establishes that the session is invalid.
- **Disposition:** `patch` — add a successful-cancellation/unauthorized-refresh case to `tests/test_history_js.cjs`.

## Other findings

- The new completeness check validates formatted strings rather than all original values. At [history.js:139](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/history.js:139), missing `attendees` becomes `"undefined 人"` before the type check at line 149; `room.capacity` has the same problem. An otherwise valid cancellation response missing `attendees` therefore replaces the preserved detail and announces success. I reproduced this without modifying repository files by changing the existing incomplete-response fixture to omit only `attendees`: its preservation assertion failed, showing `"undefined 人"` and the newly cancelled state. Validate these raw fields before formatting or replacing the existing detail.
